title: Great idea!
text: Great idea!. I love these!  I fill them just below the “pinch” with different nuts and snacks, especially when I have company.  It relieves the anxiety of seeing people stick their fingers in their mouth and put their hands back in the dish, contaminating the rest of the food. I’ll put out 5 or 6 at a time with different snacks.  My guests always comment about them and want them.  I’ve bought extras for myself and love giving them for gifts.

product_metadata.title: Artland Barkeep Bar Snackers (Set of 4), Clear
features: Artland Barkeep Bar Snackers are a creative alternative to snack servers commonly seen at parties
Instead of having a community bowl of snacks where dirty hands can touch more than they intend to take, these snackers keep the treats safe from dirty hands
When a snack is desired, simply tip the snack bowl to dispense the perfect amount into the right hands
The snackers are made of glass and come as a set of 4, perfect for your next party, playdate, sleepover or other occasion
These innovative snack canisters also present a sleeker alternative to those boring snack bowls
description: Artland Barkeep Bar Snackers are a creative alternative to snack servers commonly seen at parties.
